label: Property Listing
description: The interior shot a listing needs: verticals true, the room made to look its size, and the light balanced between the window and the lamps.
prefix: An estate agent's interior photograph of a room, shot to sell the space
suffix: verticals perfectly true with no keystoning, window exposure balanced against the interior lamps, the room staged tidy and impersonal, wide enough to read the plan without distortion
negative: fisheye distortion, tilted verticals, clutter, people in frame, watermark, signature, text artifacts, deformed, extra limbs, extra fingers
